title.original: OpenID Connect for Agents (OIDC-A) 1.0: A Standard Extension for LLM-Based Agent Identity and Authorization
title.zh: OpenID Connect for 智能体 (OIDC-A) 1.0：基于LLM的代理身份和授权的标准扩展
title.en: OpenID Connect for Agents (OIDC-A) 1.0: A Standard Extension for LLM-Based Agent Identity and Authorization

inclusion_reason.zh: OIDC-A 定义兼容 OAuth/OIDC 的 Agent Claims、证明和委托链验证流程，是可实现的跨服务身份授权协议。
inclusion_reason.en: OIDC-A defines OAuth/OIDC-compatible agent claims, attestation, and delegation-chain validation as an implementable cross-service identity and authorization protocol.

abstract.zh: OIDC-A 1.0 扩展 OpenID Connect/OAuth，为 LLM Agent 定义身份、证明、委托链和基于能力属性的授权协议。
abstract.en: OIDC-A 1.0 extends OpenID Connect and OAuth with agent identity, attestation, delegation-chain, and capability-attribute authorization mechanisms.

problem.zh: 自治 Agent 接入服务时缺少兼容现有身份基础设施的标准方式来证明“是谁、代表谁、经何委托、拥有什么能力”。
problem.en: Autonomous agents lack a standard compatible with existing identity infrastructure for proving who they are, whom they represent, their delegation path, and capabilities.

approach.zh: 规范在 OIDC 中增加 Agent 标准 Claims、端点和验证流程，并把委托链、证明材料与细粒度授权映射到 OAuth 生态。
approach.en: The specification adds standard agent claims, endpoints, and validation flows to OIDC and maps delegation, attestation, and fine-grained authorization into OAuth.

system_design.zh: 身份提供方签发含 Agent 与委托属性的 token，资源服务验证证明和链路，再依据能力、主体与范围执行访问决策。
system_design.en: Identity providers issue tokens carrying agent and delegation attributes; resource services validate attestations and chains before enforcing capability-, principal-, and scope-based access.

key_results.zh: 该规范给出可与既有 OAuth/OIDC 部署共存的完整协议骨架，为 Agent 到服务的可信身份与授权提供共同语义。
key_results.en: The specification supplies a protocol skeleton that coexists with OAuth/OIDC deployments and gives agent-to-service identity and authorization shared semantics.

limitations.zh: 这是规范提案而非互操作性实测；信任锚、证明签发、撤销、委托滥用和不同提供方治理仍需部署共识。
limitations.en: This is a specification proposal rather than an interoperability deployment; trust anchors, attestation issuance, revocation, delegation abuse, and provider governance remain unresolved.

notes.zh: 实验矩阵与数值将在全文人工复核后补充；当前留空以避免从摘要推断。
notes.en: The experiment matrix and numbers await full-text manual review; fields remain empty to avoid inferring them from an abstract.
